import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CurveParameterDerivation
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RationalDifferentialResidue

/-!
# Residues of exact rational differentials

The residue of an exact rational differential is zero for every specified
local parameter, in arbitrary characteristic. This uses denominator clearing
and the Taylor coefficient differentiation formula.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing
open scoped nonZeroDivisors

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

private theorem derivation_pow_mul_regularization
    {k K M : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing K] [Algebra k K]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [Module K M] [IsScalarTower k K M]
    (d : Derivation k K M) (t f a : K) (n : ℕ) (ha : t ^ (n + 1) * f = a) :
    t ^ (n + 2) • d f = t • d a - (n + 1) • a • d t := by
  have h := congrArg (fun m : M => t • m) (congrArg d ha)
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.leibniz_pow] at h
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
  have hsecond : t • (f • ((n + 1) • t ^ n • d t)) = (n + 1) • a • d t := by
    rw [smul_comm f (n + 1), smul_comm t (n + 1)]
    congr 1
    rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, ← ha]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h' : t ^ (n + 2) • d f + (n + 1) • a • d t = t • d a := by
    simpa only [smul_add, hsecond, smul_smul, ← pow_succ'] using
      h
  exact eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr h'

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
private theorem exists_parameter_pow_mul_eq_algebraMap
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (f : X.left.functionField) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x),
      algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField (t ^ (n + 1)) * f =
        algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField a := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨b, c, hc, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) f
  obtain ⟨n, v, hv⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible
    (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hc) ht
  refine ⟨n, t * ↑v⁻¹ * b, ?_⟩
  rw [hv]
  have htK : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht.ne_zero)
  have hvK : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField (v : _) ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr v.ne_zero)
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_units_inv]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- Exact rational differentials have zero residue for every specified
local parameter, without a characteristic restriction. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_differential
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (f : X.left.functionField) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      (KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f) = 0 := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha⟩ := exists_parameter_pow_mul_eq_algebraMap X hx t ht f
  let η : CurveStalkDifferentials X x :=
    t • KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) a -
      (n + 1) • a • KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t
  have hclear : t ^ (n + 2) • KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField η := by
    dsimp only [η]
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_nsmul, map_smul,
      KaehlerDifferential.map_D, KaehlerDifferential.map_D]
    have h := derivation_pow_mul_regularization
      (KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField)
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t) f
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField a) n
      (by simpa only [map_pow] using ha)
    simpa only [← map_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul] using h
  have hω : KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f ∈
      curvePoleDifferentials X x ((n + 1) + 1) := by
    rw [mem_curvePoleDifferentials_iff_pow_smul X hx t ht, hclear]
    exact ⟨η, rfl⟩
  have hlocal : curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht ((n + 1) + 1)
      ⟨KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f, hω⟩ = η := by
    apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
    rw [curvePoleLocalDifferential_map]
    exact hclear
  rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_higherPole X hx t ht (n + 1)
    ⟨KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f, hω⟩,
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply, hlocal]
  have hdt : (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
      (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t) = 1 :=
    curveParameterDerivation_parameter X hx t ht
  dsimp only [η]
  rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_nsmul, map_smul, hdt]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [map_sub, map_nsmul,
    localTaylorCoefficient_succ_parameter_mul,
    curveLocalTaylorCoefficient_differentialCoordinate]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, sub_self]

end
end Hartshorne
